passage:
survey — 调查
Last month, a group of volunteers in the town of Greenfield carried out a survey about local shopping habits.

respondents — 受访者
Only 18 per cent of the respondents were under 30 years old.

reliable — 可靠的
As a result, the data for this question was less reliable than the volunteers had hoped.

limitations — 局限性
Despite these limitations, the survey produced some useful trends.

trends — 趋势
Despite these limitations, the survey produced some useful trends.

sample — 样本
Also, there were more women than men in the sample: 60 per cent of respondents were women.

increase — 增长
So the new figure (65 per cent) shows an increase.

comparison — 比较
However, the volunteers warned that the two surveys used different methods, so the comparison may not be completely fair.
